results.reader_title: How EU strategic industrial projects can become durable
results.reader_what: Andreas Eisl examines EU Important Projects of Common European Interest and calls for predictable co-financing and simpler coordination.
results.reader_why: Cross-country public investment tools can support European capacity in strategic chips, batteries, hydrogen and cloud computing.
results.reader_more: The paper distinguishes an early experimental phase from a more EU-funded consolidation phase of IPCEIs. It estimates about €10.5 billion in RRF funding envelopes for four second-wave IPCEI categories, recommends predictable EU co-financing and national budget flexibility, and proposes shared administrative support. Figures are estimates derived from national recovery plans, not amounts already disbursed to final projects.
